review_scope: Fresh independent pixel review of cycle 6 only; no prior critics, appended history, TASK_STATE, or builder code/rationale read.

layout_route_readability.reason: ENTRY, REVERSE, PINCH and all cutaways maintain a clearly legible exit, open transfer area and approaches to treatment/console/decon/cot. Equipment remains concentrated around walls and does not consume the route. Physical clearances and preservation of inherited geometry are left to the independent objective/technical review.

grounded_stylized_art_silhouette.reason: OCRU frame/control modules, console hooded monitors, scissor cart, steel cot and cabinets have specific manufactured silhouettes and secondary construction. Muted mauve/navy/charcoal/russet/cream palette and restrained surface detail align with all four approved spawn references. No dominant rounded primitive, bevel-box, generic low-poly or web-demo read.

ocru_hero_functional_clarity.reason: OCRU treatment bed dominates through silhouette and single red practical. INSERT/RELEASE and SUIT housings, ARM/CONNECT/RESTART guarded controls, live status, numbered cartridges, reserve batteries and BEFORE LOADING decon form a clear clinical machinery sequence. Supporting apparatus remains subordinate.

materials_anti_plastic.reason: Rough plaster, matte painted steel, controlled bare metal, cloudy glass, dark rubber hose/wheels, vinyl treatment pads, soft recovery fabric and paper supplies remain visibly distinct. No shared room-wide glossy/satin-plastic response. Limited glancing floor highlights and coarse close-view wall grain prevent a higher score.

dark_lighting_atmosphere.reason: One red overhead bed practical supplies the dominant focal pool; a modest warm workbench practical and dim directional room accents preserve navigation. Dark ceiling, unlit fixtures, rear exit and service alcove produce depth and a bleak atmosphere without concealing the essential silhouettes. HIDDEN_BAG inspection fill is not counted.

purposeful_dressing_neglected_story.reason: Repeated no-pulse shift log and RELEASE DENIED, continuity/productivity propaganda with RECOVER/RECOMMISSION/RETURN, unattended sheet/stretcher, localized dark floor stains, wall patches/chipped cabinetry and concealed closed body bag convey coercive clinical work and restrained neglect. Orderly stock and clean operator/workbench arrangement soften the requested extreme hopelessness but do not erase the story.

combined_note: Do not substitute this visual verdict for technical validation. A technical score of at least 8.5/10 would meet both the technical category minimum and the combined >=90 threshold with this 81.6/90 visual score.

ENTRY.pixel_evidence: Open foreground route remains legible. OCRU alcove left dominates via red practical and authored steel jamb/control hardware. Console, cartridge shelf, decon opening and wall storage form an intelligible far-wall hierarchy. Blue steel, mauve plaster, dark tile and matte bedding remain distinguishable.

REVERSE.pixel_evidence: Room exit centered and legible without a bright doorway. Warm supplies practical is localized at left, red OCRU bed remains focal at right. Foreground floor boundaries remain visible. Exit lintel text is dark but framing conveys the route independently.

PINCH.pixel_evidence: Equipment wall preserves visible passage at decon and bedside approach. Console panel controls, shelves, frame trim and drawer construction read as specific institutional hardware. No dominant plastic sheen or rounded toy silhouette.

DETAIL_OCRU.pixel_evidence: Segmented treatment padding, restrained pillow volume, articulated rail/clamp construction and lift pedestal form a specific bed assembly. Steel and padding remain distinguishable under the red wash. Underside is intentionally dark; hidden bag cannot be confidently judged from this atmospheric view.

DETAIL_SUPPLIES.pixel_evidence: Scissors, tape rolls, individual glove fingers, medical packaging, pump bottle, sink and sharps container identify a plausible clinical work cluster. The shift log exposes repeated no-pulse attempts and RELEASE DENIED corporate coercion. Warm light retains paper/plastic/rubber/metal distinction. Arrangement is tidy and small bottle forms remain simple, but not a dominant primitive or plastic failure.

HERO_OCRU.pixel_evidence: Frontal hero close view clearly distinguishes patient bed, side insert/release and suit connection, support pedestals, dark hoses, chamber access panels and single overhead red practical. Angular side/control housings and bolted trim give manufactured authority rather than rounded primitive presentation. Dark central underside concealment is retained; bag verification reserved for inspection view.

HERO_RESTART.pixel_evidence: Console close view exposes a coherent guarded ARM -> CONNECT -> RESTART sequence, current OCRU/suit/cartridge/chamber status and employee-transfer monitor. Screens sit in authored hooded housings above a worktop with steel edge trim, drawers and service vent. Explicit controls support functional understanding rather than decorative UI noise.

HERO_CARTRIDGES.pixel_evidence: Numbered cartridge bank has specific bracketed tubes, shelf lips, bolted steel rails and an empty middle slot that breaks stock repetition. It visibly links operator console to BEFORE LOADING decon station. Labels communicate supplies and treatment order; color accents remain limited to utility yellow and cabinet blue.

HERO_RESERVE.pixel_evidence: Open reserve cabinet contains two recognizable battery cases with protected yellow carry bars, terminal/cable cue and orange retaining brackets. Folded steel cabinet and heavy equipment matte surfaces remain distinct. Close framing crops adjacent monitor intentionally while preserving reserve equipment identification.

HERO_DECON.pixel_evidence: Dark alcove still exposes hose reel, hanging rubber hose/nozzle, supply piping/control plate, foot-operated USED PPE bin and floor grating. Blue bolted door rails provide readable construction. Dimness supports a secondary service space without losing the equipment silhouettes.

HERO_RECOVERY.pixel_evidence: Recovery berth shows thin steel frame, raised rails, layered mattress/bedding, pillow, broad sheet folds and folded dark blanket with restrained seams. Soft fabric response contrasts with the hard frame. Cropped poster's RECOVER, RECOMMISSION, RETURN language and sign-before-leaving policy sharpen corporate pressure; hanging sheet conveys unattended human use.

HERO_CART.pixel_evidence: Transfer cart has a clearly authored scissor-lift silhouette, cross-bracing, wheels/brackets, utility-yellow handles and segmented vinyl pads. Steel frame, matte padding and dark rubber wheels separate under dim light. Loose dark floor strap-like accents remain localized beside the OCRU rather than crowding the route.

HERO_SUPPLIES.pixel_evidence: Whole workbench shows clear steel support frame, drawer, underside paper cartons, authored supply cluster, clipboard/log, mug and open tool case. Local warm illumination falls off sharply toward the right wall and floor. Small wall patches and partly loose packaging add authored use, though the overall supply arrangement is orderly.

HERO_WASH.pixel_evidence: Handwash station is recognizable from folded stainless basin/rim, faucet, waste pipe and wall-mounted soap dispenser. Bare metal is controlled rather than chrome, blue/cream dispenser plastic differs from rough plaster, and secured orange sharps container supports clinical function. Coarse plaster grain is most apparent at this close distance but remains localized rather than room-wide photographic noise.

HERO_CABINET.pixel_evidence: Medical supply cabinet has framed cloudy glass, center hinges, separate metal handles, latches/rail and sparse localized paint chips. STERILE/LINEN labels and obscured package masses identify content without excessive detail. Painted steel, translucent glass and adjacent power-isolation control retain distinct material/function reads.

CORNER_SW.pixel_evidence: Cutaway confirms an authored clinical layout with OCRU volume opposite sparse medical bed/supplies, rear operator console and decon. A portable stretcher and broad open rescue route are visible. Equipment masses support functional hierarchy without crowding the floor.

CORNER_SE.pixel_evidence: Opposite cutaway makes OCRU primary bed, operator console, cartridges and decon legible as a connected treatment sequence. Footprint retains open central transfer area and secondary cot/supplies zone. Dim red bed and modest warm supplies pool remain the two clear practical light zones.

CORNER_NW.pixel_evidence: Rear-left cutaway preserves the quiet exit wall and secondary clinical cluster. Cot, sink and supplies sit alongside the transfer route; OCRU, decon and operator equipment remain distinct. Glancing tile highlights are stronger here, but do not erase material grouping or dominate the room.

CORNER_NE.pixel_evidence: Rear-right cutaway shows door frame depth, OCRU treatment volume, portable stretcher and restrained floor staining. Broad central negative space is maintained. Grating/tile highlights appear only in limited glancing regions; no room-wide plastic read.

WALL_SOUTH.pixel_evidence: Exit wall retains a readable centered doorway, heavy frame and thick lower protection panels. Darkness beyond the exit supports mood while the floor remains traversable. Warm supply pool and red OCRU edge establish asymmetry; doorway identity does not depend on its subdued header text.

WALL_WEST.pixel_evidence: OCRU frontal wall is an authoritative angular chamber with differentiated bolted header, side control housings, treatment rails and pedestal supports. Single red overhead practical establishes the focal bed. ORGANIC CONTINUITY header, dark blood-like floor patches and unattended portable stretcher reinforce clinical exploitation and neglect. No dominant bevel-box or glossy sci-fi read.

WALL_NORTH.pixel_evidence: Operator console, cartridges and framed decon opening form a legible work sequence beside the OCRU. Upper wall/conduit rhythm is quiet and coherent. Palette closely follows approved spawn's muted mauve institutional wall, navy steel, charcoal structure, russet/orange and cream accents. Dark ceiling and alcove contrasts prevent a flat exposure.

WALL_EAST.pixel_evidence: Recovery cot has readable steel rails, mattress/pillow and an uneven draped sheet. Muted corporate continuity/productivity poster and a small framed policy sheet provide institutional pressure above the bed. Warm supplies light is localized; unlit overhead fixtures and dark cot wall support neglect. Cabinet glass remains cloudy and distinct from painted blue steel.

HIDDEN_BAG.pixel_evidence: Temporary-fill inspection exposes a fully closed dark transport/body bag under the bed, continuous zipper/seam, carrying handles and two restraint-like strips. The tiny note/tag is barely discernible as a small tan mark and its message is not legible at this distance. This view is inspection evidence only and is excluded from the lighting/atmosphere score.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Operator equipment and supplies are unusually orderly, with clean color blocks and regular stock placement. This makes neglect feel restrained rather than severe.
nonblocking_findings.impact: Minor loss of the requested hopeless/neglected intensity. Existing log, poster, localized wear/stains and abandoned bedding provide enough specific story for the category to pass.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Plaster grain becomes coarse at the closest views, especially under the warm grazing practical.
nonblocking_findings.impact: Slight high-frequency distraction compared with the broader approved spawn grouping; it does not dominate the room or create photographic grunge.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Some glancing floor seams/highlights are more conspicuous than the matte-looking floor from ENTRY/PINCH.
nonblocking_findings.impact: Local polished appearance in cutaways. It remains limited and does not create a room-wide wet-plastic read.

summary: The current pixels satisfy the six visual category minima and all 15 mandatory camera gates. Angular institutional machinery, distinct materials and restrained lighting align with the approved spawn art language while conveying bleak corporate medicine. This is a current-cycle visual pass, not final production acceptance.
